name: dg_lab_final2
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/dg_lab_final2; mkdir -p $O
python3 ../map_ground_hq.py cleanroom --px 64 --samples 32 --out $O/ground_cleanroom.png --watersrc $O/water_src_cleanroom.png > $O/ground.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/ground.log; exit 1)
ls -la $O

name: dg_neon_final2
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/dg_neon_final2; mkdir -p $O
python3 ../map_ground_hq.py neon_grid --px 64 --samples 32 --out $O/ground_neon_grid.png --watersrc $O/water_src_neon_grid.png > $O/ground.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/ground.log; exit 1)
ls -la $O
